learning_outcomes.text: Know what characteristics lead to a good visualization.
Use statistical, representative, and diagnostic graphs used to characterize data.
Implement methods for visualizing multidimensional data.
Apply data visualization techniques with temporal and spatial dependence.

syllabus_topics: Visualization models: Tables, graphs, dot maps, graphs, spatial data.
Visualization of multiple variables and dimensions.
Design and validation of visualization systems.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 must be obtained in both the final theoretical exam and the practical part of the course. Any grade below 4 will result in failing the course in the ordinary call. In extraordinary calls, the evaluation consists of a theoretical exam (50%) and practical assignment submission (50%), both requiring a minimum grade of 4 out of 10. If a student does not meet the minimum requirements in specified evaluation sections, their final grade will be the minimum between 4 and the obtained grade.
